summary: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on August 18, 2026, disclosing positive topline results from the LUCIDITY Phase 3 trial of avexitide for post-bariatric hypoglycemia. The filing includes an investor presentation and forward-looking statements regarding NDA submission and commercialization. This is a routine clinical data announcement, not a special-situation corporate event such as M&A, restructuring, or capital action. No deal terms, strategic review, or shareholder-related action are present.
